summary: Council adopted the omnibus Official Community Plan amendment (Bylaw No. 2292) following the public hearing. Council approved the City Asset Management Plan and Long-Term Financial Plan. Council issued Temporary Use Permit TUP26-0004 to Honeycomb Cannabis Inc. for 107-2317 Millstream Road for a 36‑month term. Council adopted several bylaws including Fire Prevention and Regulation Bylaw No. 1665 and Langford Zoning Bylaw Amendment No. 2248 (1234 Goldstream), with Councillor Colby Harder recorded as opposed to the Goldstream text amendment. Council directed no action on the rezoning application for 953 Walfred Road until specified variances are removed and updated plans are reviewed by Council.

items.plain_english_summary: Council resolved to consider bringing forward Bylaw No. 2290 for readings subject to specified terms and conditions; the motion carried with Mayor Goodmanson and Councillor Keith Yacucha opposed.
items.description: Council agreed to consider bringing Bylaw No. 2290 forward for first, second and third readings in future subject to multiple terms and conditions including road dedication, Section 219 covenants, consolidation, access easements, parking allocations, electric heat pump requirements, tree protection, low carbon concrete standards, and substantial compliance with presented drawings.

motions.motion_text: THAT Council: 1. motions.plain_english_summary: Council agreed to consider Bylaw No. 2290 for readings subject to detailed conditions.
motions.outcome_source_quote: Motion  CARRIED. Mayor Goodmanson and Councillor Yacucha opposed.
